generation_excerpts: Přemysl Otakar II. Square (Czech: Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II.) is a square in České Budějovice in the Czech Republic. It is the central public space in the historical city centre, named after the city's founder, Bohemian king Ottokar II (Czech: Přemysl Otakar II.). With an area of 17.968 ha (44.40 acres), it is the second largest square-shaped plaza in the Czech Republic after the square in Vysoké Mýto.
